candidates.name: INSPIRE July 2026 download
verified_facts: Dataset published 5 July 2026
New files are published on the first Sunday of each month
Downloads are partitioned by local authority
semantic_limits: Indicative extent only; not legal boundary proof

candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset
verified_facts: Each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
Dataset contains indicative position and extent of registered freehold property
Monthly files show data from the previous month
semantic_limits: Title extent cannot be established solely from INSPIRE polygons

candidates.name: INSPIRE technical guidance
verified_facts: HMLR polygons are captured against British National Grid
British National Grid is EPSG:27700
Reprojection from BNG to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres
semantic_limits: Exact parcel measurement remains in native EPSG:27700

candidates.name: INSPIRE metadata catalogue
verified_facts: Metadata last updated 8 July 2026
Dataset is published by HM Land Registry
Local-authority files and INSPIRE services are listed
semantic_limits: Metadata freshness does not replace exact local file hash evidence

candidates.name: Public data accuracy statement
verified_facts: HMLR uses internal quality processes
Data is collected from varied registration sources
HMLR does not guarantee fitness for every intended purpose
semantic_limits: No universal positional accuracy claim inferred

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m
verified_facts: Covers about 99% of England at 1m resolution
Surface objects are removed to produce bare-earth terrain
Newest best-resolution repeat surveys are used
Resampled data uses bilinear interpolation
Data is EPSG:27700 and referenced to ODN using OSTN15
Source-survey vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE
semantic_limits: Composite cells may derive from different survey dates

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2m
verified_facts: Covers about 99% of England at 2m resolution
Bare-earth DTM removes surface objects
Composite uses newest best-resolution repeat surveys
Vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE
CRS is EPSG:27700
semantic_limits: 2m product remains a cross-check and does not override the 1m primary result

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DSM 1m
verified_facts: DSM includes vehicles, buildings, vegetation and terrain
DSM is 1m resolution and EPSG:27700
Composite uses repeat-survey merging and resampling
semantic_limits: DSM is excluded from primary bare-earth parcel height difference

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DSM 2m
verified_facts: DSM 2m includes buildings, vehicles and vegetation
CRS is EPSG:27700
Vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE
semantic_limits: DSM 2m is diagnostic only, not terrain ground truth

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM 1m
verified_facts: First-return DSM includes vegetation, buildings, vehicles and terrain where first return is ground
National programme blocks are merged with overlap feathering
semantic_limits: First-return surface is not accepted as bare-earth primary DTM

candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: Archive contains 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m DTM depending survey
Data is OS Grid and ODN
Transformation is specific to survey time period
Vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE
semantic_limits: Historical tiles require explicit survey-date and datum lineage

candidates.name: Persistent LIDAR service endpoints announcement
verified_facts: Persistent LIDAR service URL pattern is intended to survive annual updates
DTM 1m and DTM 2m WCS endpoints use WCS 2.0.1
Persistent URLs provide most up-to-date published data without yearly URL changes
semantic_limits: Endpoint persistence is service lineage, not accuracy gain

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Overview
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 is updated quarterly
Product is a DTM used for terrain modelling
Published accuracy is materially coarser than sub-metre EA parcel differences
semantic_limits: Terrain 5 remains secondary sanity evidence only

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Technical Specification
verified_facts: Grid data uses regular 5m post spacing
Data is supplied in 5km by 5km tiles
GML CRS is EPSG:27700
Feature identifiers are release-specific and regenerated on tile refresh
semantic_limits: 5m grid spacing is not equivalent to sub-metre vertical accuracy

candidates.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
verified_facts: OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation
Simple Helmert is limited to about 3m applications
OSTN15 uses a 1km transformation grid and bilinear interpolation
New and archived OSGB36 coordinates agree on average better than 0.1m RMSE
semantic_limits: Horizontal transform error is kept separate from LiDAR vertical RMSE

candidates.name: ETRS89 to OSGB36 / British National Grid (3)
verified_facts: EPSG transformation code is 7953
Transformation is adopted as official definition of OSGB36 from August 2016
Transformation uses OSTN15 grid file
Accuracy by definition is exact with roughly 0.1m comparison to legacy triangulation coordinates at 67% confidence
semantic_limits: Definition accuracy does not reduce terrain-source vertical uncertainty
